description.value:
A steel bolt whose head is wrapped in a coil of humming copper.

When you hit a creature with an attack using this bolt, it arcs onward: choose up to five more creatures, each within 30 feet of the last creature the bolt hit and none of them more than once. Each of them takes the weapon's damage plus 3d10 force damage.

Once it hits, the bolt is destroyed.

midi-qol: An onUse macro on the bolt asks you for each creature in turn when the crossbow's attack hits, then uses its hidden Arc activity on all of them: the crossbow's damage dice plus its ability modifier (rolled again, never a critical) and 3d10 force.

macro.name: Chainbreaker Bolt
